title: Protocol to measure centrosome cohesion deficits mediated by pathogenic LRRK2 in cultured cells using confocal microscopy
protocol: Pre-warm A549 cell culture medium and Trypsin-EDTA solution in a 37°C water bath.
Aspirate the culture medium from the cells.
Add 1.5 mL of pre-warmed Trypsin-EDTA solution to T25 flask containing cells at 90% confluency.
Incubate the flask at 37°C for maximally 5 minutes or until all cells are detached.
Resuspend the cells with 8.5 mL of culture medium.
Disperse the cell suspension by repeatedly pipetting.
Count cells using a hemacytometer.
Pre-lay 1 mL of A549 cell culture medium into each well of a 6-well plate.
Plate 1 mL of cell suspension per well of a 6-well plate containing pre-laid medium.
Mix 100 μL of DMEM high glucose, no glutamine medium with 1 μg of LRRK2 construct.
Vortex the DNA-containing solution.
Mix 100 μL of DMEM high glucose, no glutamine medium with 4 μL of LipoD293 transfection reagent.
Vortex and incubate the LipoD293-containing solution at RT for 3 min.
Add the LipoD293-containing solution to the DNA-containing solution.
Vortex thoroughly and incubate the mixture at RT for 15 min.
Add the 200 μL transfection mix to the cells in a well of a 6-well plate gently down the side wall of the well, then gently swirl the plate to mix.
Incubate the transfected cells at 37°C in 5% CO2 for 5 h.
Gently remove medium from the cells after transfection.
Add fresh pre-warmed A549 cell culture medium to the cells.
Incubate the cells at 37°C in 5% CO2 overnight (12–16 h).
Pre-warm A549 cell culture medium and trypsin-EDTA solution in a 37°C water bath.
Aspirate the cell culture medium from the cells.
Add 0.5 ml of pre-warmed Trypsin-EDTA solution per well of a 6-well plate.
Incubate at 37°C for maximally 5 min or until all cells are detached.
Place dry-heat sterilized 13-mm round glass coverslip into each well of a 6-well plate.
Pre-lay 1 mL of A549 cell culture medium in each well containing the coverslips.
If coverslips are floating, gently push them to the bottom of the well with a sterile pipette.
Add 4 mL of A549 cell culture medium to trypsinized cells and gently disperse cells by pipetting.
Add 1 mL of cell suspension to each well containing the coverslips and pre-laid cell culture medium.
Prepare a 1 mM stock solution of MLi2 in DMSO.
Dilute the 1 mM MLi2 stock solution in A549 cell culture medium to make a 200 μM working stock solution for treatment with a final concentration of 200 nM.
For control, dilute DMSO 1:5 in A549 cell culture medium to generate an equivalent 1000x stock.
Treat cells transiently overexpressing LRRK2 with MLi2 at 100-200 nM for 2 hours.
Treat cells endogenously expressing LRRK2 with MLi2 at 10-50 nM for 2 hours.
Keep the final DMSO concentration on cells to ≤ 0.1% (v/v).
Remove cell culture medium from treated cells.
Fix the cells with 2 mL of PFA fixing solution (4% v/v in PBS) for 15 minutes at 37°C.
Remove the fixing solution after fixation.
When staining with anti-γ-tubulin antibody, fix cells additionally with ice-cold absolute MeOH for 5 minutes in a freezer at -20°C.
Pre-chill absolute MeOH at -20°C for at least 24 hours for optimal fixation.
Fix MEF cells with ice-cold pre-chilled MeOH in freezer at -20°C for 10 minutes.
Permeabilize the cells for 10 min by incubation with 2 ml of PBST at room temperature.
Transfer the coverslips to a 24 well plate to minimize all subsequent incubation volumes.
Block for 1 hour at room temperature with 500 μL of blocking solution.
Incubate at 4°C overnight (12–16 h) with 100 μL of blocking solution containing primary antibodies diluted at 1:1000 (v/v).
Simultaneously stain cells with rabbit anti-pericentrin and mouse anti-γ-tubulin antibodies for non-transfected cells.
Simultaneously stain cells with both rabbit anti-pericentrin and mouse anti-flag antibodies for transfected A549 cells.
Wash coverslips 3 times with 1 mL of PBST (0.2% Triton-X100/PBS) for 10 min at room temperature.

Incubate coverslips for 1 h at room temperature with 100 μL of blocking solution containing fluorescently-conjugated secondary antibodies (goat anti-mouse AlexaFluor488 and goat anti-rabbit AlexaFluor 594 diluted at 1:1000 (v/v)).
Wash coverslips 3 times with 1 mL of PBST for 10 min at room temperature.
Incubate coverslips with secondary antibodies in 24-well plates protected from light.
Wash the incubated coverslips under protection from light on a rocker-shaker.
Pick up the coverslips with forceps and dip into a beaker containing deionized water.
Dip the coverslips into a beaker containing 70% EtOH.
Place the coverslips onto a Kimwipe with cells facing up to air-dry.
Add around 4 μL of mounting medium with 1.5 μg/mL DAPI onto a slide.
Ensure no air bubbles are present in the drop of the mounting medium before placing it on a slide.
Place dried coverslip onto drop of mounting medium (cells facing down).
Remove excess mounting medium from edges of the coverslip using a Kimwipe.
Code individual coverslips so image acquisition and analysis can be performed blind to conditions.
Use a 488 nm Argon laser line and a 510–540 nm emission band pass for Alexa Fluor 488.
Use a 561 nm HeNe laser line and a 596–628 nm emission band pass for Alexa Fluor 594.
Use a 405 nm UV diode and a 420–470 nm emission band pass for DAPI.
Acquire 15–20 image sections with a z-step size of 0.5 μm.
Select areas based on the presence of transfected cells when imaging centrosome cohesion from cells transiently overexpressing LRRK2, and only image healthy-looking transfected cells.
Image random areas across the coverslip if imaging cells endogenously expressing LRRK2.
Determine the mean distance between duplicated centrosomes from control wildtype cells for any given cell type to define centrosome splitting.
Generate maximal intensity projections of all acquired images.
Process images using Leica Applied Systems (LAS AF6000) image acquisition software.
Analyze images in ImageJ.
Exclude mitotic cells from analysis based on DAPI staining.
Quantify the percentage of non-transfected interphase cells displaying two centrosomes out of 100 random cells.
Measure the distance between duplicated centrosomes from 150 to 200 independent wildtype cells manually.
Plot a frequency histogram of the distances between duplicated centrosomes from control wildtype cells using GraphPad Prism 9 software.
Perform the same analysis with cells endogenously expressing pathogenic LRRK2.
Plot the distances between duplicated centrosomes in wildtype versus R1441C-LRRK2 cells.
Repeat the experiment twice more.
Obtain the average mean distances between duplicated centrosomes from wildtype versus R1441C-LRRK2 MEFs.
Conduct experiments in both the absence and presence of MLi2.
Define “centrosome splitting” as the percentage of cells with a distance between duplicated centrosomes greater than 5 μm.
Calculate the average splitting phenotype for wildtype versus R1441C-LRRK2 MEFs.
Determine the maximal diameter of the nucleus from around 20 cells as identified by DAPI staining to obtain a mean nuclear diameter value.
Exclude occasional cells where the distances between their duplicated centrosomes are larger than the mean nuclear diameter.
Exclude MEF cells with inter-centrosome distances > 20 μm.
Exclude A549 cells with inter-centrosome distances > 5 μm.
Exclude all cells with more than two centrosomes from further analysis.
